summary: Nuvation Bio Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $200M offering of convertible senior notes due 2032. The notes carry an undisclosed interest rate, mature July 1, 2032, and are convertible into common stock under certain conditions including stock price triggers. The company may redeem the notes after July 2029. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine capital markets transaction. The filing describes terms and conversion mechanics, but no advisory fees, board recommendations, or structural changes are mentioned.
